precise_next_target.statement: For any source relation with incomparable a,b both below c, no map to finite lists can both preserve and reflect the source relation as List.IsPrefix. Ancestors of one target address are comparable. Instantiate the four-element Boolean subset lattice as an actual finite diamond.
essential_hypotheses: Preservation sends both a,b below c to prefixes of f c.
Reflection turns target prefix comparability back into a<=b or b<=a, contradicting source incomparability.
Injective monotonicity alone is insufficient: a linear extension can introduce extra target comparisons. Do not claim this weaker premise excludes maps.
required_controls: Actual finite diamond obstruction plus a valid chain-prefix embedding.
Concrete injective monotone map whose target introduces source-incomparable comparisons, demonstrating the need for reflection.
precise_next_target.reuse_and_duplicate_policy: Do not duplicate or silently promote candidate ancestor lemmas. Prefer exact pinned List.IsPrefix APIs and a genuinely new embedding obstruction/consumer; if a candidate is used, first discharge its own fresh audit/admission and preserve historical receipts.
